title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Twenty-Five thousand Pesos for the Printing of the "Diario De Sesiones" of the Philippine Legislature, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated the sum of twenty-five thousand pesos out of the funds in the
Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated to defray the expenses for the printing of the "Diario de Sesiones"
of the Philippine Legislature.

The printing of the "Diario de Sesiones" and the disbursement of the funds herein appropriated
as well as the distribution of said "Diario de Sesiones" shall be made under the direction and supervision of
the Presidents of both Houses or of the officer or person they may designate.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 1, 1934.
